name: jp.softglow/storycanon
title: StoryCanon
description: A structured story bible for long-form fiction. Read and write scenes, chapters, characters, world notes, plot threads, foreshadowing, mysteries, revision TODOs, a timeline and story-state snapshots, so the work survives the end of the conversation.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token. Only needed for clients that cannot do OAuth — the server advertises OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration, so connector-style clients obtain their own token from the URL alone. Hand-issued tokens come from the Settings page.
